target: Target C: Recoverable Workspace and Checkpoint Blockers
scenario_description: Temporarily missing workspace directories or corrupt latest checkpoints with valid parent fallback remain safely guarded in WAITING without irreversible terminal FAILED transitions.

findings.missing_workspace_behavior: Mission transitions to status=WAITING, wait_reason=WAITING_FOR_WORKSPACE, recovery_required=True. No tool execution permitted.
findings.workspace_reconnection_behavior: When directory is remounted/restored, coordinator re-evaluates eligibility; workspace identity is re-verified and disk reconciled before execution.
findings.corrupted_latest_checkpoint_behavior: If latest checkpoint is damaged, coordinator queries parent_checkpoint_id. If valid parent exists, fallback occurs; if no valid parent, mission remains blocked in WAITING without permanent FAILED transition.
findings.user_stopped_preservation: Missions cancelled or stopped by user remain fenced even if workspace or checkpoint recovers.
